quiz.explanation: 切割，切割图案。The artist would incise a pattern. 艺术家会切割图案。 | in->进入，cis->切（拉丁caedere），incise->切入=雕刻（cf. incision切口，scissors剪刀，precise精确，concise简洁，decide决定） || 文化联想：玉雕工匠在玉佩表面刻入云纹、龙纹时最适合联想到 incise，可以说 **incise a pattern — “A jade carver may incise a cloud pattern into the surface with a fine tool.”**

quiz.question: exorcise ______
quiz.explanation: 驱魔，驱魔。The priest tried to exorcise demons. 牧师试图驱魔。 | ex->向外，orcis->发誓（希腊horkos），exorcise->用誓言驱出=驱魔（cf. exercise锻炼=向外驱动，exorcism驱魔，oath誓言） || 文化联想：钟馗捉鬼是中国民间最经典的驱邪形象之一，很适合帮助记忆 exorcise，可以说 **exorcise evil spirits — “In folk tradition, an image of Zhong Kui is believed to exorcise evil spirits and protect the household.”**

quiz.question: excise ___
quiz.explanation: 消费税，消费税。Pay the excise tax on tobacco. 缴纳烟草消费税。 | ex->向外，cis->切（拉丁caedere），excise->切掉/消费税（cf. incise刻入，precise精确，concise简洁，decision决定） || 文化联想：现代税制中对某些特定消费品征收消费税，可以帮助记忆 excise，可以说 **an excise tax — “A government may levy an excise tax on selected goods such as tobacco or other specially taxed products.”**

quiz.question: disfranchise ______
quiz.explanation: 剥夺选举权，剥夺选民选举权。The law would disfranchise voters. 该法律会剥夺选民选举权。 | dis->否定，franchise->特许/选举权（古法语franc->自由），disfranchise->剥夺自由权利=剥夺选举权（cf. franchise特许，freedom自由） || 文化联想：现代选举中如果把本来符合资格的人从选民名单中非法删除，就会剥夺其选举权，可以说 **disfranchise voters — “Removing qualified citizens from an electoral roll without lawful reason would disfranchise voters.”**

quiz.question: _____ premise
quiz.explanation: 前提，基本前提。The basic premise is flawed. 基本前提有缺陷。 | pre->之前，mis->放置（拉丁mittere），premise->提前放置的=前提（cf. mission使命，promise承诺，submit提交，emit发出） || 文化联想：《孙子兵法》“知己知彼”可以看成制定战略的基本前提，很适合联想到 premise，可以说 **a basic premise — “The idea that one should know both oneself and the opponent is a basic premise of sound strategy.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ compromise
quiz.explanation: 妥协，达成妥协。They tried to reach a compromise. 他们试图达成妥协。 | com->共同，pro->向前，mis->放置，compromise->共同向前放置=妥协（cf. promise承诺，premise前提，commit承诺，promise承诺） || 文化联想：中文“各退一步，海阔天空”最适合帮助记忆 compromise，可以说 **reach a compromise — “When both sides ‘take one step back,’ they may reach a compromise and avoid a larger conflict.”**

quiz.question: _________ counterpoise
quiz.explanation: 平衡力量，政治平衡力量。A political counterpoise was needed. 需要政治平衡力量。 | counter->对抗，poise->平衡（法语pois->重量），counterpoise->对抗的重量=平衡力（cf. poise平衡，equipoise平衡，counterweight对重） || 文化联想：阴阳相济强调两种力量彼此制约、保持平衡，可以作为 counterpoise 的文化联想，可以说 **a counterpoise of forces — “The yin-yang image suggests a counterpoise of forces in which neither side completely overwhelms the other.”**

quiz.question: turquoise ____
quiz.explanation: 绿松石，绿松石戒指。She wore a turquoise ring. 她戴着绿松石戒指。 | turquois->土耳其的（法语），turquoise->土耳其石=绿松石（绿松石经土耳其传入欧洲，cf. Turkey火鸡/土耳其，turquoise蓝绿色） || 文化联想：西藏和青海传统首饰里常见绿松石镶嵌，最适合联想到 turquoise，可以说 **a turquoise ornament — “A Tibetan-style necklace may feature a bright turquoise ornament set beside coral and silver.”**

quiz.question: _______ reprise
quiz.explanation: 重复，音乐重复。The musical reprise ended the show. 音乐重复结束了演出。 | re->再次，pris->拿取（拉丁prehendere），reprise->再次拿起=重复（cf. reprisal报复，surprise突袭=从上面拿，enterprise企业=之间拿） || 文化联想：大型晚会结尾再次出现开场主题旋律，很适合联想到 reprise，可以说 **a musical reprise — “At the end of a gala, the opening theme may return as a musical reprise that brings the program full circle.”**

quiz.question: apprise __ _____
quiz.explanation: 通知，通知事实。Please apprise of facts immediately. 请立即通知事实。 | ap->朝向，pris->评估（法语，拉丁pretium->价格），apprise->朝向评估=通知（cf. appraise评估，price价格，prize奖品，apprise告知） || 文化联想：古代“八百里加急”把军情迅速送往朝廷，很适合联想到 apprise，可以说 **apprise the court of the facts — “An urgent courier could ride day and night to apprise the court of the facts on a distant frontier.”**

quiz.question: _____________ treatise
quiz.explanation: 论文，哲学论文。He wrote a philosophical treatise. 他写了一篇哲学论文。 | traiter->处理（法语，拉丁tractare），treatise->系统处理某主题的著作（cf. treat处理，treatment治疗，tract论文，treatise专论） || 文化联想：《孙子兵法》系统讨论战争原则，是 treatise 最典型的中国文化联想之一，可以说 **a military treatise — “The Art of War is a concise military treatise on strategy, deception, terrain, and command.”**

quiz.question: _________ expertise
quiz.explanation: 专业知识，技术专业知识。She had technical expertise. 她有技术专业知识。 | expert->专家（拉丁expertus->经过检验的），expertise->专家的知识（cf. expert专家，experience经历，experiment实验，export出口） || 文化联想：景德镇老师傅对配釉、烧窑、控温积累的专业本领最适合联想到 expertise，可以说 **technical expertise — “Producing fine Jingdezhen porcelain requires technical expertise in clay, glaze, kiln temperature, and firing.”**

quiz.question: advertise ______
quiz.explanation: 做广告，在线做广告。Companies advertise online now. 公司现在在线做广告。 | ad->朝向，vert->转（拉丁vertere），advertise->转向注意=做广告（cf. advertise广告，divert转移，revert恢复，convert转变，invert颠倒） || 文化联想：直播带货和电商平台是当代中国非常熟悉的线上广告场景，最适合联想到 advertise，可以说 **advertise online — “A small tea company may advertise online through livestreams and e-commerce platforms to reach customers across China.”**

quiz.question: chastise _____
quiz.explanation: 惩罚，惩罚孩子。Parents may chastise child for misbehavior. 父母可能会因不当行为惩罚孩子。 | chaste->纯洁（拉丁castus->纯洁），chastise->让变纯洁=惩罚（cf. chaste纯洁，chastity贞洁，chasten惩戒，castigate严惩） || 文化联想：“严师出高徒”常把老师的严厉训诫与学生成长联系起来，可帮助记忆 chastise，可以说 **chastise a student — “In an old-style school, a stern teacher might verbally chastise a student for repeatedly neglecting his lessons.”**

quiz.question: _____ ___ guise __
quiz.explanation: 伪装，以...为幌子。He acted under the guise of friendship. 他以友谊为幌子行事。 | guise->外表（古法语guise，日耳曼语wisa->方式），guise->外在形式=幌子（cf. disguise伪装，wise方式，likewise同样地，otherwise否则） || 文化联想：中文“挂羊头卖狗肉”最适合帮助记忆 guise，因为它强调以一种好名义掩盖另一种实质，可以说 **under the guise of something — “A dishonest shop that ‘hangs a sheep’s head but sells dog meat’ operates under the guise of offering something better than it really does.”**

quiz.question: revise _____
quiz.explanation: 修改，修改草稿。Please revise draft carefully. 请仔细修改草稿。 | re->再次，vis->看（拉丁videre），revise->再次看=修改（cf. vision视觉，visit访问，revise修改，revision修订，supervise监督） || 文化联想：中文“文章不厌百回改”最适合帮助记忆 revise，可以说 **revise a draft — “The saying ‘good writing can be revised a hundred times’ encourages a writer to revise a draft again and again.”**

quiz.question: improvise _ ____
quiz.explanation: 即兴创作，即兴创作曲调。The musician would improvise a tune. 音乐家会即兴创作曲调。 | im->否定，pro->之前，vis->看，improvise->未事先看过=即兴（cf. provide提供，provision供应，improvise即兴，impromptu即兴） || 文化联想：民间唢呐手或戏曲乐师常根据现场气氛临时加花、变奏，很适合联想到 improvise，可以说 **improvise a tune — “A skilled folk musician may improvise a tune or ornament the melody differently depending on the occasion.”**

quiz.question: _______ supervise
quiz.explanation: 监督，密切监督。The manager would closely supervise. 经理会密切监督。 | super->在上，vis->看（拉丁），supervise->从上方看=监督（cf. vision视觉，visit访问，revise修改，supervisor监督者） || 文化联想：古代大型工程都有监工盯着工匠、材料和进度，很适合帮助记忆 supervise，可以说 **closely supervise the work — “An official overseeing a major canal project would closely supervise the workers, materials, and construction schedule.”**

quiz.question: _____ pulse
quiz.explanation: 脉搏，心跳脉搏。Check the heart pulse regularly. 定期检查心跳脉搏。 | puls->推动（拉丁pellere），pulse->推动的节拍=脉搏（cf. repulse击退，impulse冲动，compel强迫，propel推进，expel驱逐） || 文化联想：中医“把脉”就是通过手指感受脉搏变化，最适合帮助记忆 pulse，可以说 **feel the pulse — “A traditional Chinese physician places fingers on the wrist to feel the pulse and assess its rhythm and quality.”**

quiz.question: repulse ______
quiz.explanation: 击退，击退攻击。The army would repulse attack. 军队会击退攻击。 | re->向回，puls->推（拉丁pellere），repulse->推回=击退（cf. pulse脉搏，impulse冲动，compel强迫，expel驱逐，propel推进） || 文化联想：长城守军击退敌军进攻的场景最适合联想到 repulse，可以说 **repulse an attack — “Defenders on a frontier fortress might use arrows, walls, and reinforcements to repulse an attack.”**

quiz.question: ______ impulse
quiz.explanation: 冲动，突然冲动。He acted on a sudden impulse. 他出于突然冲动行事。 | im->进入，puls->推（拉丁），impulse->推进内部=冲动（cf. pulse脉搏，repulse击退，compel强迫，expel驱逐，impulsive冲动的） || 文化联想：中文常说“冲动是魔鬼”，最适合帮助记忆 impulse，可以说 **a sudden impulse — “The warning ‘冲动是魔鬼’ reminds people not to act on a sudden impulse before thinking through the consequences.”**

quiz.question: convulse ____ ________
quiz.explanation: 使痉挛，笑得痉挛。The audience would convulse with laughter. 观众会笑得痉挛。 | con->共同，vuls->扯（拉丁vellere），convulse->剧烈扯动=痉挛（cf. revulsion憎恶=向后扯，avulsion撕脱，convulsion痉挛） || 文化联想：相声包袱抖得好时，观众常笑得前仰后合，很适合联想到 convulse，可以说 **convulse with laughter — “A perfectly timed xiangsheng punch line can make the audience convulse with laughter.”**

quiz.question: ______'_ license
quiz.explanation: 执照，驾驶执照。Renew your driver's license. 更新你的驾驶执照。 | licere->被允许（拉丁），license->被允许的权利=执照（cf. licit合法，illicit非法，leisure闲暇=被允许的时间，licentious放纵） || 文化联想：中国驾车上路必须持有相应驾驶证，最适合帮助记忆 license，可以说 **a driver’s license — “A driver must carry a valid driver’s license before legally operating a car on public roads.”**

quiz.question: _______ incense
quiz.explanation: 香，燃烧的香。Burning incense filled the temple. 燃烧的香充满了寺庙。 | in->使，cens->燃烧（拉丁censere），incense->使燃烧的东西=香/使愤怒（cf. incendiary纵火的，census调查，censer香炉，incensed愤怒的） || 文化联想：寺庙里香炉青烟袅袅是中国人最熟悉的 incense 场景，可以说 **burning incense — “Visitors to a temple may offer burning incense before a shrine as part of a devotional ritual.”**

quiz.question: condense _____
quiz.explanation: 凝结，凝结蒸汽。Cool air would condense steam. 冷空气会凝结蒸汽。 | con->共同，dens->密集（拉丁densus），condense->使密集=凝结（cf. dense密集，density密度，condenser冷凝器，condensed milk炼乳） || 文化联想：蒸包子时锅盖内侧的水蒸气变成小水珠，最适合帮助记忆 condense，可以说 **steam condenses — “When baozi are steamed, hot vapor touches the cooler lid and the steam condenses into droplets of water.”**

quiz.question: immense ________
quiz.explanation: 巨大的，巨大的压力。He felt immense pressure to succeed. 他感到巨大的压力要成功。 | im->否定，mens->测量（拉丁mensura），immense->无法测量的=巨大的（cf. measure测量，dimension维度，immeasurable无法衡量，enormous巨大） || 文化联想：三峡大坝这样的大型水利工程必须承受巨大的水压，很适合联想到 immense，可以说 **immense pressure — “A massive dam must withstand the immense pressure exerted by the water stored behind it.”**

quiz.question: _____ recompense
quiz.explanation: 补偿，提供补偿。They would offer recompense for damages. 他们会为损失提供补偿。 | re->再次，com->共同，pens->称量/付款（拉丁pendere），recompense->再次称量偿还=补偿（cf. compensate补偿，expense费用，pension养老金） || 文化联想：“滴水之恩，当涌泉相报”最适合帮助记忆 recompense，可以说 **recompense a kindness — “The saying ‘repay a drop of kindness with a gushing spring’ expresses the desire to recompense a kindness generously.”**

quiz.question: __________ suspense
quiz.explanation: 悬念，加剧的悬念。The music created heightened suspense. 音乐制造了加剧的悬念。 | sub->在下，pens->悬挂（拉丁pendere），suspense->悬挂在下方=悬念（cf. suspend悬挂，pendant悬挂物，pendulum钟摆，impending迫近） || 文化联想：说书人讲到最紧张处突然来一句“欲知后事如何，且听下回分解”，最适合联想到 suspense，可以说 **heighten the suspense — “By ending with ‘If you want to know what happens next, listen to the next episode,’ a storyteller can heighten the suspense.”**

quiz.question: commonsense ________
quiz.explanation: 常识的，常识的解决方案。That's a commonsense solution. 那是常识的解决方案。 | common->共同，sense->感觉（拉丁sentire），commonsense->共同的感觉=常识（cf. sense感觉，sensible明智，consent同意，resent怨恨） || 文化联想：中文“量入为出”是非常典型的常识性理财原则，最适合联想到 commonsense，可以说 **a commonsense rule — “The principle ‘spend according to what you earn’ is a commonsense rule for keeping a household budget under control.”**

quiz.question: rinse _____
quiz.explanation: 冲洗，冲洗周期。Select the rinse cycle. 选择冲洗周期。 | rincen->冲洗（古法语，来源不明），rinse->用清水冲洗（cf. rinse冲洗，cleanse清洗，flush冲洗，wash洗，cycle循环） || 文化联想：中国家庭做饭前淘米时要用清水反复冲洗，最适合帮助记忆 rinse，可以说 **rinse the rice — “Before cooking, many families rinse the rice with clean water to remove dust and excess surface starch.”**

quiz.question: verbose ______
quiz.explanation: 冗长的，冗长的报告。The verbose report was too long. 冗长的报告太长了。 | verb->词（拉丁verbum），ose->充满...的，verbose->充满词语的=冗长的（cf. verbal口头，verbatim逐字，verbiage冗词，verbose啰嗦） || 文化联想：中文有句调侃“老太太的裹脚布——又臭又长”，常用来讽刺文章啰嗦冗长，很适合联想到 verbose，可以说 **a verbose report — “A report mocked as ‘like an old foot-binding cloth—smelly and long’ is certainly a verbose report.”**

quiz.question: bellicose ________
quiz.explanation: 好战的，好战的言辞。His bellicose rhetoric was alarming. 他好战的言辞令人担忧。 | bell->战争（拉丁bellum），icose->充满...倾向，bellicose->充满战争倾向的（cf. belligerent交战，belligerence好战，rebel反叛，antebellum战前） || 文化联想：古代战书若满篇喊打喊杀、语气咄咄逼人，就很适合联想到 bellicose，可以说 **bellicose rhetoric — “A challenge letter threatening immediate war is filled with bellicose rhetoric rather than conciliatory language.”**

quiz.question: _____ glucose
quiz.explanation: 葡萄糖，血糖。Monitor blood glucose levels. 监测血糖水平。 | glukus->甜（希腊），ose->糖类后缀，glucose->甜的糖=葡萄糖（cf. glycerin甘油，lactose乳糖，fructose果糖，sucrose蔗糖） || 文化联想：米饭里的淀粉经过消化后会分解并最终转化为葡萄糖，最适合联想到 glucose，可以说 **blood glucose — “After a bowl of rice is digested, its carbohydrates can raise blood glucose as glucose enters the bloodstream.”**

quiz.question: ____ overdose
quiz.explanation: 过量，药物过量。The patient suffered a drug overdose. 患者遭受了药物过量。 | over->过多，dose->剂量（希腊dosis->给予），overdose->过多剂量（cf. dose剂量，dosage用药量，antidote解毒剂=反向给予） || 文化联想：中文“是药三分毒”提醒药物不能随意多吃，很适合帮助记忆 overdose，可以说 **a drug overdose — “The saying ‘every medicine has some toxicity’ is a useful reminder that taking too much of a drug can cause an overdose.”**

quiz.question: metamorphose ____
quiz.explanation: 变形，变形成。The caterpillar would metamorphose into a butterfly. 毛毛虫会变形成蝴蝶。 | meta->变化（希腊），morph->形状，ose->动词化，metamorphose->形状变化=变形（cf. metamorphosis变形，morphology形态学，amorphous无形的） || 文化联想：孙悟空七十二变是中国文化里最适合帮助记忆 metamorphose 的形象，可以说 **metamorphose into another form — “In Journey to the West, Sun Wukong can metamorphose into animals, objects, and other forms through his transformations.”**

quiz.question: grandiose ______
quiz.explanation: 浮夸的，浮夸的计划。His grandiose scheme failed. 他浮夸的计划失败了。 | grand->宏大（法语，拉丁grandis），iose->充满...的，grandiose->过于宏大的=浮夸的（cf. grand宏大，grandeur宏伟，grandma奶奶，grande大） || 文化联想：《阿房宫赋》把秦宫描写得极其宏大奢华，很适合联想到 grandiose，可以说 **a grandiose scheme — “The enormous palace project described in the ‘Rhapsody on Epang Palace’ evokes a grandiose scheme of imperial construction.”**

quiz.question: otiose ______
quiz.explanation: 无用的，无用的努力。That was an otiose effort. 那是无用的努力。 | otium->闲暇（拉丁），ose->充满...的，otiose->充满闲散=无用的（cf. negotiate谈判=不闲着，leisure闲暇，idle闲散，redundant多余） || 文化联想：成语“画蛇添足”最适合帮助记忆 otiose，因为多画的脚完全多余无用，可以说 **an otiose addition — “The extra legs in the story ‘Drawing a Snake and Adding Feet’ are an otiose addition that only ruins the original work.”**

quiz.question: foreclose _ ________
quiz.explanation: 取消抵押品赎回权，取消抵押贷款赎回权。The bank would foreclose a mortgage. 银行会取消抵押贷款赎回权。 | fore->提前，close->关闭，foreclose->提前关闭=取消赎回权（cf. close关闭，closure关闭，disclose披露，include包括） || 文化联想：现代房贷如果长期断供，贷款机构可能依法处置抵押房产，这很适合联想到 foreclose，可以说 **foreclose on a mortgage — “If a borrower stops making mortgage payments for a long period, a lender may seek to foreclose on the mortgaged property through the legal process.”**

quiz.question: disclose _______
quiz.explanation: 披露，披露细节。Please disclose details of the plan. 请披露计划的细节。 | dis->分开，close->关闭（拉丁claudere），disclose->打开=披露（cf. close关闭，enclose围住，foreclose取消赎回权，recluse隐士） || 文化联想：中文“开诚布公”最适合帮助记忆 disclose，可以说 **disclose the details — “To act with complete openness, officials should disclose the details rather than hide important facts from the public.”**

quiz.question: lachrymose _____
quiz.explanation: 催人泪下的，催人泪下的戏剧。The lachrymose drama was emotional. 催人泪下的戏剧很感人。 | lacrima->泪水（拉丁），ose->充满...的，lachrymose->充满泪水的=催泪的（cf. lachrymatory装泪的瓶，tear泪，weepy爱哭的） || 文化联想：中国“苦情戏”里人物动不动就泪流满面、身世凄惨，很适合联想到 lachrymose，可以说 **a lachrymose drama — “A television melodrama filled with tearful reunions and tragic misunderstandings can become a thoroughly lachrymose drama.”**

quiz.question: _______ ___ noose
quiz.explanation: 套索，收紧套索。They would tighten the noose. 他们会收紧套索。 | noose->套索（可能来自古挪威nos->绳结），noose->可滑动收紧的套圈（cf. lasso套索，lasso rope，snare陷阱，noose收紧） || 文化联想：古装刑罚场景里的绞索可以帮助记忆 noose，但它只是绳圈这种物件本身，可以说 **a hanging noose — “In a grim historical execution scene, a hanging noose may be shown as the looped rope used for strangulation.”**

quiz.question: ______ _ pose
quiz.explanation: 姿势，摆姿势。The model would strike a pose. 模特会摆姿势。 | pos->放置（拉丁ponere），pose->摆放自己的位置=姿势（cf. position位置，posture姿态，impose强加，compose作曲，expose暴露） || 文化联想：京剧演员登场时一个定格“亮相”就是非常典型的 pose，可以说 **strike a dramatic pose — “At the end of a movement, a Peking-opera performer may strike a dramatic pose and hold it for the audience.”**

quiz.question: juxtapose _____
quiz.explanation: 并置，并置想法。The essay would juxtapose ideas. 文章会并置想法。 | juxta->紧邻（拉丁），pos->放置，juxtapose->紧邻放置=并置（cf. position位置，juxtaposition并置，adjacent邻近，contiguous毗连） || 文化联想：中国对联把上下两联并排放置、彼此映照，很适合帮助记忆 juxtapose，可以说 **juxtapose two lines — “A traditional couplet juxtaposes two matching lines so that their parallel images and meanings can be compared side by side.”**

quiz.question: depose _ _____
quiz.explanation: 废黜，废黜统治者。The rebels would depose a ruler. 叛军会废黜统治者。 | de->向下，pos->放置，depose->从高处放下=废黜（cf. deposit存款=向下放，compose作曲，oppose反对，dispose处置，expose暴露） || 文化联想：武王伐纣最终推翻商纣王，可以作为 depose 的历史联想，可以说 **depose a ruler — “In traditional historical narrative, King Wu’s victory over the Shang brought down the last Shang ruler and effectively deposed him.”**

quiz.question: impose _ ___
quiz.explanation: 征收，征收税收。The government would impose a tax. 政府会征收税收。 | im->在上，pos->放置，impose->放置在上面=强加（cf. impost进口税，composer作曲家，depose废黜，dispose处置，superimpose叠加） || 文化联想：中文“苛捐杂税”最适合帮助记忆 impose，因为它让人联想到统治者把税负强加给百姓，可以说 **impose a tax — “A government that repeatedly imposes new levies may be accused of burdening ordinary people with ‘苛捐杂税.’”**

quiz.question: superimpose ______
quiz.explanation: 叠加，叠加层。Superimpose layers in the image. 在图像中叠加层。 | super->在上，im->在上，pos->放置，superimpose->在上面再放=叠加（cf. impose强加，superimposition叠加，overlay覆盖，layer层） || 文化联想：修复古画时如果把新的数字图层叠在原图上进行比对，很适合联想到 superimpose，可以说 **superimpose one image on another — “A conservator can superimpose a digital reconstruction on a scan of an old painting to compare missing details.”**

quiz.question: compose _______
quiz.explanation: 使镇定，使自己镇定。Take time to compose oneself. 花时间使自己镇定。 | com->共同，pos->放置，compose->把自己放置整齐=使镇定/创作（cf. composure镇定，decompose分解，dispose处置，impose强加） || 文化联想：“泰山崩于前而色不变”最适合帮助记忆 compose oneself，可以说 **compose oneself — “A person who remains steady even if ‘Mount Tai collapses before him’ can compose himself under extraordinary pressure.”**

quiz.question: decompose _____
quiz.explanation: 分解，分解废物。Bacteria decompose waste naturally. 细菌自然分解废物。 | de->去除，com->共同，pos->放置，decompose->去除结合=分解（cf. compose组合，composure镇定，compost堆肥，component成分） || 文化联想：农村把菜叶、秸秆等有机废物堆肥，让它们慢慢腐烂变成肥料，很适合联想到 decompose，可以说 **decompose into compost — “Vegetable scraps and crop residue can decompose into compost that is later returned to the soil.”**

quiz.question: interpose _ ________
quiz.explanation: 插入，插入问题。He would interpose a question. 他会插入问题。 | inter->之间，pos->放置，interpose->放置在之间=插入（cf. impose强加，depose废黜，compose作曲，dispose处置，repose休息） || 文化联想：古代廷议中御史突然插入一个质问、打断原来的陈述，可以帮助记忆 interpose，可以说 **interpose a question — “During a heated court debate, a censor might interpose a question that forces the speaker to address an uncomfortable point.”**

quiz.question: dispose __ _____
quiz.explanation: 处理，处理废物。Properly dispose of waste. 妥善处理废物。 | dis->分开，pos->放置，dispose->分开放置=处理（cf. disposition倾向，depose废黜，compose作曲，imposing壮观，predisposed倾向） || 文化联想：现代垃圾分类后，不同垃圾要按规定处理，最适合帮助记忆 dispose，可以说 **dispose of waste properly — “Households are expected to sort rubbish and dispose of waste properly rather than dump it wherever convenient.”**

quiz.question: transpose ____
quiz.explanation: 移调，移调音调。Transpose keys for the singer. 为歌手移调音调。 | trans->跨越，pos->放置，transpose->移到另一位置=移调（cf. transport运输，transfer转移，translate翻译，transform变形） || 文化联想：把《茉莉花》改到更适合歌手音域的调上，最适合帮助记忆 transpose，可以说 **transpose a song — “A musician may transpose ‘Jasmine Flower’ into a lower key so that it better fits a singer’s vocal range.”**

quiz.question: prose _____
quiz.explanation: 散文，散文风格。He wrote in a clear prose style. 他用清晰的散文风格写作。 | prosa->直接的话（拉丁，prorsus->直接向前），prose->直接的写法=散文（cf. prosaic平淡，verse诗，poetry诗，prosy冗长无聊） || 文化联想：五四以后白话文逐渐成为现代中文写作的重要形式，最适合帮助记忆 prose，可以说 **vernacular prose — “Writers of the New Culture Movement helped make vernacular prose a major form of modern Chinese literature.”**

quiz.question: comatose _______
quiz.explanation: 昏迷的，昏迷的病人。The comatose patient needed care. 昏迷的病人需要护理。 | coma->深度无意识（希腊koma->深睡），tose->状态，comatose->昏迷状态（cf. coma昏迷，comma逗号=koma同源，somnolent困倦） || 文化联想：古装剧里重伤人物长时间昏迷不醒的情节很适合联想到 comatose，可以说 **a comatose patient — “After a severe head injury, a character may remain a comatose patient who does not respond to family members.”**

quiz.question: relapse ____ _______
quiz.explanation: 复发，复发疾病。He would relapse into illness. 他会复发疾病。 | re->再次，laps->滑落（拉丁labi->滑），relapse->再次滑落=复发（cf. lapse失误，collapse倒塌，elapse流逝，labile不稳定） || 文化联想：中文常说“旧病复发”，就是病情好转后又再次出现，很适合联想到 relapse，可以说 **relapse into illness — “A patient who seems to recover but then becomes sick again may relapse into illness.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ glimpse
quiz.explanation: 瞥见，瞥见。I managed to catch a glimpse. 我设法瞥见了。 | glimpse->瞥见（中古英语，来自glimsen->闪光），glimpse->短暂的一瞥（cf. glimmer微光，gleam闪光，glance一瞥，gaze注视） || 文化联想：苏州园林的漏窗故意只露出一小片竹影或山石，最适合联想到 glimpse，可以说 **catch a glimpse — “Through a pierced window in a Suzhou garden, a visitor may catch a glimpse of bamboo, rock, and water beyond the wall.”**

quiz.question: rehearse _____
quiz.explanation: 排练，排练台词。Actors rehearse lines before performance. 演员在演出前排练台词。 | re->再次，herse->耙子（古法语herce->耙），rehearse->再次耙过=重复练习（cf. hearse灵车=耙形框架，rehearsal排练，repeat重复） || 文化联想：京剧演员正式登台前要反复排练唱词和念白，最适合联想到 rehearse，可以说 **rehearse one’s lines — “Before a Peking-opera performance, actors rehearse their lines, entrances, gestures, and musical cues repeatedly.”**

quiz.question: coarse ________
quiz.explanation: 粗俗的，粗俗的语言。Avoid coarse language. 避免粗俗的语言。 | coarse->粗糙（可能来自course->通常=ordinary），coarse->不精细的=粗俗（cf. course课程/过程，coarse粗糙，cf. coarse vs course区别） || 文化联想：市井争吵里满口粗俗脏话最适合帮助记忆 coarse，可以说 **coarse language — “A street quarrel filled with insults and vulgar expressions is full of coarse language.”**

quiz.question: terse _____
quiz.explanation: 简洁的，简洁的回复。He gave a terse reply. 他给出了简洁的回复。 | tersus->擦干净（拉丁），terse->干净利落的=简洁（cf. terse简洁，concise简洁，laconic简洁，pithy精辟，succinct简洁） || 文化联想：中文“言简意赅”最适合帮助记忆 terse，可以说 **a terse reply — “A response that uses only a few words but makes the meaning completely clear is a terse reply—‘言简意赅.’”**
